subject: Semantic hardening of adversarial publication records

phases.claim_or_design_tested: The v1 adversarial record validator prevents incomplete or misleading records from being treated as publication-ready.
phases.challenge_method: Inspected the exact v1 validator and constructed safe in-memory counterexamples using unknown decision vocabulary, omitted publication-evidence inventories, empty evidence arrays, and blank evidence items.
failures_or_counterexamples_found: Unknown decisions such as blocked were not rejected.
A phase could provide an empty evidence array and still satisfy structural validation.
Blank evidence items were not rejected.
No explicit inventory captured evidence still required before publication.
repairs_made: Selected an additive v2 wrapper to preserve v1 consumers.
Required non-empty string evidence and an explicit publication-evidence inventory at every checkpoint.
Required publication, adoption, or canonicalization to fail while any publication evidence remains outstanding.
remaining_uncertainty: String evidence can still be stale, fabricated, or non-commit-matched.
No canonical publication command is proven to invoke v2.
phases.evidence_quality: Exact repository source inspection plus disposable counterexample design; no deployment, automation, schedule, shared-state, or user-data mutation.
phases.next_falsifiable_step: Attempt to validate an unknown decision and an empty evidence array; both must return valid=false.
evidence_required_before_publication: Exact-commit runtime output for the v2 test suite
Proof that the canonical publication path invokes v2 fail-closed

phases.claim_or_design_tested: The additive v2 validator rejects the identified semantic false positives without throwing on malformed phases.
phases.challenge_method: Executed seven disposable local Node fixtures covering a valid blocked record, unknown decision, omitted evidence inventory, blank evidence, empty evidence, publication with outstanding evidence, and a null phase.
evidence: Observed result: 7 passed, 0 failed, exit code 0
failures_or_counterexamples_found: No tested semantic counterexample bypassed v2.
The disposable execution was content-matched but was not run from a checkout at the exact committed SHA.
V2 validates evidence syntax but not provenance, freshness, digest, or factual adequacy.
repairs_made: Added seven committed negative and positive controls.
Kept the validator dependency-free and additive.
Preserved fail-closed behavior for malformed phases without touching operational systems.
remaining_uncertainty: Existing record producers may not yet emit evidence_required_before_publication.
phases.evidence_quality: Executed disposable tests and committed source; sufficient for source-contract hardening, insufficient for operational publication success.
phases.rollback_route: Revert test commit 633c974166ef867088bd5dea0ff35d3dd18fc20d, then implementation commit 925929d68ad19734b49e5d3a03b5acc68ea01a7f.
phases.next_falsifiable_step: Execute operations/continuity/validate-adversarial-review.v2.test.cjs from exact commit 633c974166ef867088bd5dea0ff35d3dd18fc20d and retain output and runtime identity.

phases.claim_or_design_tested: The committed v2 implementation and controls match the tested design and justify publication success.
phases.challenge_method: Fetched both files at exact commit 633c974166ef867088bd5dea0ff35d3dd18fc20d, confirmed their blobs and semantic controls, then challenged success against missing exact-commit execution and missing canonical gate binding.
evidence: Exact source inspection confirms decision, evidence-item, inventory, and outstanding-evidence controls.
failures_or_counterexamples_found: Source presence does not prove runtime passage at the exact commit.
No canonical publication entrypoint is proven to invoke v2.
Evidence remains free text and may be weak, stale, duplicated, or fabricated.
repairs_made: Blocked publication rather than representing source-level hardening as operational enforcement.
Recorded exact blob identities, evidence limitations, and rollback order.
remaining_uncertainty: Canonical integration and producer compatibility are unproven.
Structured provenance and freshness validation remain future work.
phases.evidence_quality: Exact-commit repository inspection plus non-commit-matched disposable execution; strong source evidence, incomplete publication evidence.
phases.rollback_route: Revert this evidence commit, then 633c974166ef867088bd5dea0ff35d3dd18fc20d, then 925929d68ad19734b49e5d3a03b5acc68ea01a7f.
phases.next_falsifiable_step: Run node --test operations/continuity/validate-adversarial-review.v2.test.cjs at the exact repository head, retain SHA, Node version, stdout, stderr, and exit code, then prove the canonical publication path rejects decision=blocked.
evidence_required_before_publication: Inventory of producers and direct v1 consumers
